regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, introduction, and lower two-column Results and discussion text
regions.finding: Article metadata and reaction-class context were reviewed. The introduction cites prior copper- and iron-mediated work; those citations are not current-paper experiments. The optimization narrative maps to Table 1 rows on page 2 and was merged rather than duplicated.

The prose discusses solvent, catalyst-loading, reagent-equivalent, and quench-temperature screens. It conflicts with the page-2 table for entry 1 (86% prose vs 88% table) and entry 12 (71% prose vs 75% table); both values are retained in their row records.

unresolved: Optimization scale, workup, and purification are absent from the supplied main text.
No SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 2 upper half, Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1-18, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Eighteen distinct optimization experiments were retained row-by-row, including catalyst omission, reagent-equivalent overrides, 7 h duration, 0 °C quench, NMR yields, starting-material recovery, byproduct yield, and Z/E selectivity.

regions.region: page 2 lower half, Table 2 reaction drawing, entries 1-17, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Seventeen distinct substrate-scope experiments were retained row-by-row. Shared conditions are 0.4 mmol allenoate, 3 equiv Grignard reagent, 5 mol% CuCl, 5 mL toluene, and -78 °C; row times, combined isolated yields, 2/3 ratios, and the vinylMgBr footnote were structured.

unresolved: Minor regioisomer structures 3a-3q are not fully assigned from the table drawing and remain label-only except 3a.
Connectivity candidates and stereochemistry require expert review.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left continuation of scope discussion
regions.finding: Narrative support for Table 2 entries 12-17 (phenyl and vinyl Grignard reagents) was linked to the existing table-row records; no duplicate experiments were created.

regions.region: page 3 center-left Scheme 1, four arrows from in-situ Z-4
regions.finding: Four distinct electrophile-trapping experiments were retained: acetone to Z-5, methyl p-toluenesulfonate to E-6, benzyl bromide to E-7, and allyl acetate to E-8, including times, yields, contamination footnote, and crude-NMR E/Z ratios where printed.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Figure 1 and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: NOE correlations support the depicted alkene configurations but do not constitute additional preparative reactions. The surrounding Z-4 to E-4 explanation is linked to the plausible-mechanism record on page 4.
Commercial Grignard solution concentrations and toluene drying information were reviewed as shared materials context; only experiment-specific concentrations were placed in records.

unresolved: NOE assignments and full stereochemical structures remain machine-unverified.
The paper mentions supplementary data, but no SI was supplied or associated.

regions.finding: Plausible Z-4/E-4 isomerization mechanism with anti/syn allylic metallic intermediates; classified as mechanism, not as an observed experiment.

regions.region: page 4 left column, section 4.2 general procedure
regions.finding: Shared nitrogen atmosphere, -78 °C Grignard addition within 6 min, TLC monitoring, NH4Cl quench, extraction/washes/drying, and silica chromatography were merged into the matching Table 2 records.

Detailed preparations for Z-2a through Z-2g and the beginning of 2h were reconciled with Table 2 entries 1-8, including actual masses, amounts, catalyst loadings, Grignard solution volumes/concentrations, and product masses.

unresolved: Spectral characterization was not modeled as separate reaction records.

regions.finding: The cross-page preparation of 2h was merged with Table 2 entry 8; 79.6 mg and 92% were retained.
Detailed preparations Z-2i through Z-2q were reconciled with Table 2 entries 9-17, including actual catalyst loadings, scales, reagent concentrations, product masses, and entry-specific eluents.
The acetone trap of in-situ Z-4 to Z-5 is a two-stage experiment; quantities, -78 °C timing, workup, chromatography, 76.0 mg, and 69% yield were merged with Scheme 1 rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left completion of Z-5 characterization
